adjustment_policy: Store the Yahoo daily bar as returned, including adj_close. Do not treat adj_close as a point-in-time price. Phase 1 does not build features and does not send any series to Jev.
window_note: History starts on 2025-03-03 so a later six-month test ending 2026-09-22 still has a 52-week high and a 200-session average on its first decision day. A 7–8 month download would leave both undefined for most of that test.
